title: Summer Skincare Routine for Oily Skin in India
ex: A short summer skincare routine for oily skin in India: gel face wash, light moisturiser, sunscreen you reapply, and a thin night cream.

rd: A simple summer skincare routine for oily skin in India: gel face wash, light moisturiser, sunscreen you reapply outdoors and a thin layer of night cream.
keyword: summer skincare routine for oily skin India
quick: For oily skin in an Indian summer, wash with a gentle gel cleanser, use a light oil-free moisturiser and SPF 30 sunscreen in the morning, and reapply sunscreen outdoors. At night, double cleanse and use a thin layer of night cream. Avoid harsh scrubs.
facts: Oily skin still needs a light moisturiser in summer.
Skin renews roughly every 4–6 weeks; allow 8–12 weeks for a more even look.
Twice-daily cleansing is enough for most oily skin.
